passage: Before Saturday’s clothing swap, please put clean shirts on hangers if you have them. We’ll have spare hangers at the door. Clothes you want back if they aren’t taken should go on the rack by the window, with your name on a tag. Clothes you don’t want back can go on the long table. We’ll send anything left on that table to our partner shop. If you come late, you can still put clothes out. Just don’t leave your own bag under either display; take it to the bench so people won’t mistake it for part of the swap.
passageZh: M：星期六參加衣物交換前，如果有衣架，請先把洗乾淨的上衣掛好。入口處有備用衣架。若衣物無人拿走而你想收回，請掛到窗旁的架子，並用標籤寫上你的名字。不必收回的衣物可以放到長桌。我們會把長桌上沒人拿走的衣物送到合作店家。晚到還是可以把衣物拿來交換。自己的袋子不要放在任何一處展示區下方，請拿到長椅，才不會讓人誤以為那也是交換物品。
